disposition_reason: Thirty-two infant foods and six infant formulae from Maltese pharmacies and supermarkets were analysed by MP-AES for Cr, Cu, Hg, Ni, Fe, Mn and Zn; Table 3 gives mean ± deviation per product category. Lead, cadmium and arsenic were not analysed.

study.design: Retail survey of infant foods and formulae (minerals, toxic metals, HMF)
study.method: HNO3/H2O2 digestion then dry ashing 500 °C 6 h; microwave plasma AES (Agilent MP-AES 4100)
study.qa: Method validated per Berg; no CRM or recoveries reported; triplicates

unresolved: Lead, cadmium and arsenic were not measured.
Pear-based mercury mean 0.12 mg/kg is below the stated LOQ (0.2391 mg/kg) and would be a sub-LOQ value; kept as printed.
Mercury by MP-AES at 253.652 nm without cold vapor is an unusual method; LOD 0.0789 mg/kg.
Formula soy or milk base not stated.
